title: deploy-versions
description: Versions of a Jamstack site to build alongside HEAD. Each entry produces one historical build keyed by its slug.

key.description: URL slug for this version. Becomes a path segment in the deployed site and the value of SITE_VERSION_KEY at build time.

tag.description: Git ref (tag or branch) to clone for this version's source. Passed to `git clone --depth 1 -b <tag>`.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the version switcher UI. Defaults to `key` if omitted.
